description: This file declares the HttpRequest class used for handling HTTP requests within the rialto::servermanager namespace. It includes methods for retrieving request details such as method, command, post data, and parameters, as well as a reply method to send responses. The class encapsulates connection and request information, referencing external mongoose library components.

classes.name: HttpRequest
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP request, providing accessors for request details and a method to send responses.

methods.name: HttpRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HttpRequest object with a connection and request info.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command or endpoint of the request.

methods.name: getPostData
methods.description: Returns the POST data payload of the request.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters extracted from the request.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Sends a reply message back through the connection.
